description: This file defines the Title class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for chart title management. It includes properties and methods for handling the caption, overlay setting, and layout of a chart title.

classes.name: Title
classes.description: Represents a chart title, including its caption, overlay option, and layout.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Title object with optional caption, layout, and overlay settings.

methods.name: getCaption
methods.description: Returns the caption content, which can be a string, array, or RichText object.

methods.name: getCaptionText
methods.description: Returns the caption as plain text, consolidating RichText or array segments.

methods.name: getOverlay
methods.description: Returns whether overlay of other elements is allowed.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout object or null.
